firstDispatch.outcome: Both OS jobs failed in source replay before build. The application helper captured the underlying error and did not expose it, so its cause is not established.

followupChecks: The application helper now includes replay stderr on failure; a wrong archive produces its specific hash-mismatch diagnostic.
CMakeCache source identity rejects a candidate source paired with a different build; the matching macOS source/build passes all ten headless tests.
actionlint and Python syntax checks pass.
The public codeload archive downloaded locally matched the previously pinned SHA-256; the hosted download hash was not recorded by the first dispatch.

With global and system Git config disabled, the previous replay failed at the same second patch. Explicit core.autocrlf=input now makes replay and clean-worktree application pass with exact expected output hashes.
With global and system Git config disabled, injected fifth-patch failure restored the original bytes and a clean retry passed.
A disposable checkout including the exact FreeCAD attributes file reproduced the direct-application failure.

The helper now checks clean source bytes against the pinned archive, installs only five files produced by isolated replay, and compares the result with a second replay. On the attributes checkout it passed with global and system Git configuration disabled.
An injected failure during file installation restored all five original byte sequences, and a retry passed on the same attributes checkout.
Replay refuses a nonempty export directory without modifying its sentinel.

secondDispatch.outcome: Both OS jobs failed applying the second patch to dxf.h during archive replay. The archive hash check had passed.

rootCause: Archive replay required core.autocrlf=input. The full FreeCAD checkout also has src/Mod/.gitattributes marking Import/** -text, which prevents the same intermediate normalization during direct git apply. Earlier local sparse worktrees omitted that attributes file.

thirdDispatch.outcome: Archive replay passed, but applying the second patch to the full checkout failed on both hosts. The helper reported restoration of original bytes.

fourthDispatch.outcome: Linux and Windows source replay and candidate application passed; both jobs entered pinned-environment installation. Build and probe remain pending.
